description: Implement the complete Knowledge Base page replacing the placeholder in src/pages/KnowledgeBase.tsx with a fully designed page matching the specification exactly.
steps: Replace the entire contents of dashboard/src/pages/KnowledgeBase.tsx with the full implementation
Import Card from @/components/common/Card, all needed lucide-react icons, and recharts components (PieChart, Pie, Cell, Tooltip, ResponsiveContainer)

Define static mock data at the top of the file for: stat cards (6 items), articles (6 rows), categories list (7 items), content type distribution donut chart (5 segments), AI usage insights (4 items), recent activity (6 items), popular articles (5 items), quick actions (5 items)
Implement Page Header with Book icon, title 'Knowledge Base', subtitle, and 3 right-side buttons (AI Assistant teal outlined, Import Docs outlined, green + New Article)

Implement 6 stat cards in a grid row with colored icon backgrounds: Total Articles (356, pink), Categories (24, green), Total Views 30d (4,892, blue), Useful Votes (1,245, teal), AI References 30d (2,103, orange), Avg Relevance Score (92.6%, purple with circular progress)
Implement filter bar with search input, 4 dropdown selects (All Categories, All Tags, All Agents, All Types), Filters button, and list/grid view toggle
Implement tab navigation: All Articles (active), My Articles, Bookmarked, Recently Updated, Drafts, Archived

Implement articles table with columns: Article (title+description), Category (colored badge), Type (colored badge), Last Updated (date+author), Views, Relevance (percentage with colored bar), Actions (star + more). 6 rows of data as specified.
Implement pagination: 'Showing 1 to 6 of 356 articles', page buttons (< 1 2 3 ... 60 >), '10 / page' dropdown

Implement bottom three-column section: (1) Knowledge Categories list with colored dots and article counts, (2) Content Types Distribution donut chart using recharts with center text '356 Total' and legend, (3) AI Usage Insights with 4 stat items and 'View AI Analytics' link
Implement right sidebar (w-80) with: Recent Activity section (6 items with timestamps), Popular Articles section (numbered list with view counts), Quick Actions section (5 action buttons with icons)
Use the flex gap-4 layout pattern with flex-1 main content and w-80 flex-shrink-0 sidebar (same as Tasks.tsx and GitRepos.tsx)
Ensure all colors match: white for primary text, gray-400 for secondary, green arrows/change indicators, proper badge colors per specification
acceptance_criteria: npm run build passes with zero TypeScript errors
The page uses the Card component from @/components/common/Card
All 6 stat cards render with correct values, icons, and colored backgrounds
The donut chart uses recharts PieChart/Pie/Cell components
The right sidebar uses w-80 flex-shrink-0 pattern
All article data matches the specification exactly (titles, categories, types, dates, authors, views, relevance percentages)
All mock data is static/hardcoded with no API calls or randomness
verification: Confirm zero errors in TypeScript compilation and Vite build
